## What's New in v1.6

### New Features
- Added two new Tor bridge engines: obfs4 and WebTunnel, for better connectivity on heavily filtered networks
- Added Tor circuit verification to confirm the connection is actually routed through Tor after connecting
- Added dedicated brand icons for the obfs4 and WebTunnel engines

### Improvements
- Upgraded the Xray core to v26.9.9 for better performance, stability and protocol support
- Refined the Smart Hybrid engine and engine coordinator for more reliable automatic engine selection and fallback
- Improved bridge management and connection handling for Snowflake, WARP and Aether
- Improved Xray configuration handling, including stricter security checks and Reality/TLS link parsing
- Polished the interface: main screen, stats, splash screen, radial gauge, live server map, theme and design tokens
- Updated the in-app guide and refreshed all engine icons
- Improved IP information lookup

### Notes
- If you experience connection issues after updating, try switching engines from Settings
